R1_bit_identity_reported.expectation: Stated before running: bit-identity across platforms is not guaranteed and is the main risk to L1. If libm or code generation differs anywhere on a cell's path, that cell's draws are a different realisation at the same seed, and its pass/fail is then a fresh draw from the same sampler. We expect the funnel (pure Rust, few transcendental calls per gradient) and some low-dimensional models to be bit-identical, and some cells, especially ODE and HMM models, not to be.
